dedupe_keys.name: uberflutungstiefen fur außergewohnliche ereignisse in stadt und umland

description: Überflutungstiefen für außergewöhnliche Ereignisse in Stadt und Umland is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW). This dataset shows the flood depths for exceptional heavy rain events in Hamburg. As climate change progresses, the frequency and intensity of heavy rain events will also increase in Hamburg. The map provides information on where to expect flooding depths in the event of extraordinary events. Coverage: Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW). The portal shows the English title as "Flood depths for extraordinary events in the city and surroundings" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Behörde für Stadtentwicklung und Wohnen (BSW). Its keywords include Geodaten, REGI, ENVI, hmbtg. The listing shows 2024-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
